s: Im mitztorpin lezimmun im lav, ubo b' seipim: shenayim sheakelu keachat, im niqbeu biqbiut hammoelet letzarep lezimmun bishlosha, ap al pi sheshshenayim en reuyim lezimmun, velaken tzarik kol echad lebarek leatzmo lekattechilla, mikkol maqom, im echad yodea lebarek vehashsheni eno yodea — mebarek hayyodea umotzi mi sheeno yodea. Vetzarik lekavven milla bemilla lekol mah sheyyomar hambarek, vehambarek tzarik lekavven lehotzio yede chobato. Veim tzarik sheyyihyeh haam haaretz mebin bilshon haqqodesh, nitbaer besiman qp"h:
Ezo hi qebiut hammitztarepet lezimmun? Keshehesebu al hammittot, o sheyyashebu beshulchan echad, o belo shulchan bemappa achat, bizman hazzeh sheen lanu hasibba, o sheqqabeu [chaser]:
